NOAA has issued an El Niño Watch as conditions are expected to develop within the next six months. A number of projections point to around an 80-90 percent chance of a strong El Niño taking hold. Historically, a strong El Niño is associated with fewer tropical systems overall, but it only takes one to create major impacts.
